Jensen Huang’s return to NVIDIA has brought the spotlight back on a unique group of business leaders known as Boomerang CEOs — executives who leave a company but eventually return to take charge again.
But Jensen Huang is not the first CEO to make headlines with a comeback. From Sam Altman’s dramatic return to OpenAI in just four days to Steve Jobs’ historic comeback at Apple after 12 years, several big names have followed a similar path.
